name: GTN 2002 Expansion
researcher_notes: Matched against the existing rows for this system. P0231 is the main line (1,353 mi). P3171 is the 2024 GTN Xpress project, a different project. No row covers the 2002 loops, so this is not a match. The EIA August 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 259, lists PG&E-NW 2002 Expansion by Gas Transmission Northwest: completed November 2002, 21 miles, 42 inch, 207 MMcf/d additional capacity, 129.4 million dollars cost, FERC docket CP01-141, interstate. Length is 21 mi (33.8 km), above the 25 km floor. The project is completed, so the concrete step is met. Capacity is the incremental figure. Only one source (EIA, one origin) was checked, so the tier is medium. A FERC order for CP01-141 would be a good second source but was not pulled. Start and end locations, parent, and route were not found in the source and are left blank. Route type is unavailable. Owner spelling matches the existing entity Gas Transmission Northwest LLC. Cost value is 129.4 million scaled to full dollars. The EIA name for this project is PG&E-NW 2002 Expansion.
